# AskedFirst

> AskedFirst helps local businesses (plumbers, HVAC, electricians, roofers, dentists and small law firms) get named when customers ask AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity who to hire. Serving the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand. Contact: hello@askedfirsthq.com

## How it works
- We ask AI assistants 10 real customer questions for a business's trade and city and score how many times the business is named (0-10).
- We fix what is missing: website text, LocalBusiness schema, consistent listings, review requests and local guide mentions.
- Monthly plans are charged only in months the score goes up. One business per trade per city.

## Pricing (USD)
- AI Visibility Report: free
- Fix Pack: $49 one time
- Done For You: $249 one time
- Growth: $79/month, only in months the score goes up
- Pro: $199/month, only in months the score goes up
- Multi-City (up to 5 cities): $1,999/month, only in months the total score goes up
